text:
Maria G.: Suncrest renewal embedding job — quick async standup
Hey team, ran the bulk re-embed for Suncrest last night (~1.2M vectors). Seeing ~10% webhook failures when pushing results to their ingestion endpoint (504 + some 429). Quick run-through: what I did / blockers / today:
- Did: kicked off re-embed with retries enabled on our side
- Blockers: 504 timeouts from customer endpoint, intermittent 429s (no Retry-After honored), our pusher currently retries immediately which might amplify the problem
- Today: plan to add exponential backoff + circuit-breaker, and queue failed payloads for retry. Also will ping customer for IP whitelist. Anyone already digging in?

Ajay K.: I pulled the pusher logs — we’re dropping into the retry loop without exponential backoff. sample response headers:
```
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Time-out
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2026 07:12:03 GMT
Server: envoy
```
I can add jittered backoff + honor Retry-After if present.

Maria G.: perfect. sample error payload (truncated):
```json
{ "item_id": "s-12345", "status": "failed", "error": "504 Gateway Time-out" }
```
Would prefer we also write failures to the retry queue before giving up rather than dropping.

Sam R.: I pushed a quick staging change that limits concurrency to 8 and sets per-request timeout 20s — tests look green. opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pusher/pull/432
I can extend the backoff logic in the same PR if Ajay is ok with me iterating there.

Leah P.: Heads-up — I have the Suncrest customer sync at 3:00pm PT. Please avoid any prod deploys until after the call unless it's an emergency. If we need an immediate hotfix I’ll join the deploy window.

Ajay K.: ack. I’ll add backoff + queueing in a new commit and mark the PR for post-call canary. Also will add metrics (failed_enqueue, retry_count).

Maria G.: sounds good. For the queue, SQS fallback works for me — ensure messages carry correlation_id header so CS can trace.

Ajay K.: will do. quick config snippet I plan to add to pusher config.yaml:
```yaml
pusher:
  concurrency: 8
  timeout_seconds: 20
  backoff:
    strategy: exponential
    base_ms: 200
    max_ms: 30000
  retry_queue: suncrest-failures
```

Sam R.: nice — will review Ajay's commits tomorrow morning PT. If Leah insists on no prod till after the call, we can stage canary right after.

Maria G.: @Leah P. I’ll file/update CS ticket #4832 with the incident notes and link to PRs. Please copy anything you want me to mention on the call. :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled a canary for pusher v1.4.3 (suncrest fixes) at 2026-02-09 16:50 PT. Canary link: https://deploys.redwood.dev/canary/9876

Leah P.: :thumbsup: thanks — I’ll be on the call and will confirm when customer is good for a post-call canary.

Maria G.: thanks everyone — follow-ups: Ajay = backoff + queue + metrics, Sam = PR review, Leah = customer sync & deploy ok, me = update CS ticket and monitor. Will check back after the call.
